apply_strategy: targeted existing service IDs; preserve unmentioned resources/settings; never apply the partial SDK graph

phases.name: fresh-baseline
checks: exact project/environment/service/volume IDs
environment created after 2025-10-16
no staged changes
rollback deployment/image/settings captured
preservation repository verified
fresh source sizes and measured one-client growth
capacity report passes below projected 50%

phases.name: approve-exact-delta
checks: Claude approves exact wiring diff and CI
pinned image manifest unchanged
CPU/RAM and monthly cost approved
PID policy resolved
portal image source resolved
UTC cron and first due approved
exact new-resource identities and volume cost approved

phases.name: closed-preparation
checks: explicit sitting GO
ingress closed
trigger disabled
existing volumes remain at /data with original IDs/size/region
existing backupSchedules preserved
Compliance commissioned once against legacy Ledger before supervisor switch
dedicated coordination secret and direct matching copies
URL references only; no secret references

phases.name: controlled-rollout
checks: digest-pinned owner deployment in owner_start_order
native app health plus control authentication
coordinator observer and trigger bound to admin digest
external routes switched only after readiness
no native-port bypass
client admission remains closed

phases.name: backup-and-restore
checks: nightly UTC cron first due and observer cadence set and read back
all five locally sealed and verified
restart and actual traffic reopen proven, not READY_CLOSED alone
remote B2 snapshots plus complete catalog verified
B2-only restore into approved empty targets
application balances acceptance and hashes pass
temporary target deletion and usage evidence
only now separately approve removing platform backupSchedules and read back

phases.name: client-admission
checks: LOCKED alert proven
operator report procedure ready
live Stripe configuration and SOW price approved
fresh capacity report below 50% including projected client growth
separate founder admission GO

failure_policy: Stop on first failed check; keep ingress closed and trigger disabled, retain evidence. Restore recorded image/settings only after state compatibility proof; otherwise B2-only restore into an approved empty target. Never overwrite a running or nonempty store.
unresolved: targeted provider apply payload and exact identity reconciliation
nightly UTC cron and first due
new resource provisioning and cost approval
